entries.name: reservation-retry-keeps-idempotency-key

kills.name: fulfillment serializes competing reservations and shipments, fences stock writers, and rebuilds projections
kills.expected: an exact reservation retry must replay without executing again

entries.name: stock-reducers-observe-live-reservations

kills.name: fulfillment serializes competing reservations and shipments, fences stock writers, and rebuilds projections
kills.expected: an adjustment must not reduce stock below live reservations

entries.name: correction-validates-resulting-reservation-backing

kills.expected: a correction must not restore reservation coverage above resulting on-hand

entries.name: lifecycle-replay-precedes-fresh-revision-check

kills.name: fulfillment serializes competing reservations and shipments, fences stock writers, and rebuilds projections
kills.expected: Fulfillment target revision is no longer current
